cumulativeSpotlightRule: The active strategy is the primary spotlight of the generated teacher script, board frames, and follow-up moves. Earlier foundational habits still support it naturally; they are never banned when coaching later weeks.

strategies.name: Open Question + Wait Time (5–7s)
strategies.mechanism: Replace closed recall with one open reasoning/prediction question tied to the Science topic, plus 5–7s silent wait time so every pupil prepares an answer before anyone speaks.
strategies.teacherMoveQuote: Why do you think ___? Take 5 quiet seconds to think before hands.
strategies.teacherMove: "Why do you think ___? Take 5 quiet seconds to think before hands." (TM-T01)
strategies.pupilTarget: Moves from instant 1-word recall to prepared reasoning: "I think ___ because ___."

ms.name: Soalan Terbuka + Masa Menunggu (5–7s)
ms.mechanism: Gantikan soalan hafalan tertutup dengan satu soalan menaakul atau ramalan mengikut topik Sains, disusuli 5–7 saat masa senyap supaya semua murid bersedia menjawab.
ms.teacherMoveQuote: Mengapa kamu fikir ___? Ambil 5 saat senyap untuk berfikir sebelum angkat tangan.
ms.pupilTarget: Beralih daripada jawapan satu perkataan kepada penaakulan bersedia: "Saya fikir ___ kerana ___."

coachHints: Ask ONE open reasoning or prediction question tied to the topic ('Why do you think ___?', 'What would happen if ___?'). Replace any closed recall question ('What is ___?', 'Name the ___').
Write the wait-time cue into every teacher script that asks a question: 5–7 seconds of silent thinking, no hands yet, before anyone speaks (TM-T01 Wait Time).
Sentence frames target prepared reasoning ('I think ___ because ___.') rather than one-word recall.

strategies.name: Safe Rehearsal (Think-Pair-Share + L1 Bridge)
strategies.mechanism: Lower anxiety before whole-class sharing via 1–2 min partner rehearsal welcoming Iban / Sarawak Malay; normalise unfinished ideas and mistakes as learning steps.
strategies.teacherMoveQuote: Tell your partner first — Iban or Malay is fine — then try one English line together.
strategies.teacherMove: "Tell your partner first — Iban or Malay is fine — then try one English line together." (TM-T02)
strategies.pupilTarget: Safe pair rehearsal before public speaking; pupils try ideas without fear of being wrong.

ms.name: Latihan Selamat (Fikir-Pasang-Kongsi + Jambatan B1)
ms.mechanism: Kurangkan rasa gementar sebelum berkongsi di hadapan kelas melalui 1–2 minit latihan berpasangan dalam bahasa Iban atau Melayu Sarawak; anggap kesilapan sebagai langkah belajar.
ms.teacherMoveQuote: Beritahu pasangan dahulu — bahasa Iban atau Melayu tidak mengapa — kemudian cuba satu ayat Inggeris bersama.
ms.pupilTarget: Murid berlatih secara selamat bersama pasangan sebelum bercakap di hadapan kelas tanpa takut salah.

coachHints: Before any whole-class sharing, script a 1–2 minute partner rehearsal (Think-Pair-Share / Turn and Talk, TM-T02).
Explicitly welcome Iban and Sarawak Malay in the pair talk, then ask partners to try one English line together.
Normalise unfinished ideas and mistakes as learning steps: no praise or correction during rehearsal; pupils try ideas without fear of being wrong.

strategies.name: Deliberate Vocabulary & EAL Sentence Ladder
strategies.mechanism: Pre-teach 3–5 Tier-3 Science nouns + 2 relational connectors (because, more than, causes) using choral rehearsal (I say, you say), L1/BM cognate bridges, and a 3-rung board frame.
strategies.teacherMoveQuote: In Iban/Malay we say [L1]. In Science, say it with me: [term]. Point and say...
strategies.teacherMove: "In Iban/Malay we say [L1]. In Science, say it with me: [term]. Point and say..." (Primer + Strand 2)
strategies.pupilTarget: Uses target Science term accurately across 3 board rungs (word -> 2-choice cloze -> causal frame).

ms.name: Kosa Kata Terancang & Tangga Ayat EAL
ms.mechanism: Ajar awal 3–5 istilah Sains utama dan 2 kata hubung (kerana, lebih daripada, menyebabkan) melalui sebutan beramai-ramai, jambatan bahasa Iban/BM, dan rangka papan 3 tahap.
ms.teacherMoveQuote: Dalam bahasa Iban/Melayu kita sebut [B1]. Dalam Sains, sebut bersama saya: [istilah]. Tunjuk dan sebut...
ms.pupilTarget: Menggunakan istilah Sains dengan tepat melalui 3 tahap papan (perkataan -> pilihan -> ayat sebab).

coachHints: Pre-teach 3–5 Tier-3 Science nouns plus 2 relational connectors (because, more than, causes) with choral rehearsal ('I say, you say') and L1/BM cognate bridges.
Teacher script pattern: 'In Iban/Malay we say [L1]. In Science, say it with me: [term]. Point and say ...'
Board frames must be a 3-rung sentence ladder: word -> 2-choice cloze -> causal frame. Target: pupils use the Science term accurately across all three rungs.
Never fabricate uncertain technical Iban: use an everyday Iban descriptive phrase with the Malay/English cognate and flag it for the teacher to check.

strategies.name: Uptake Moves (Revoice, Probe & Evidence)
strategies.mechanism: Break teacher-talk IRF ("Good, next"): revoice L1 or partial answers into clear Science English, then press for evidence from the diagram or test.
strategies.teacherMoveQuote: So you are saying [revoice]. Say more — what in the picture/test makes you say that?
strategies.teacherMove: "So you are saying [revoice]. Say more — what in the picture/test makes you say that?" (TM-T03 + TM-T04)
strategies.pupilTarget: Links claim to evidence: "My evidence is ___ which shows that ___."

ms.name: Langkah Sambutan (Ulang Suara, Gali & Bukti)
ms.mechanism: Hentikan pola "Bagus, seterusnya": ulang suara jawapan murid dalam bahasa Sains yang jelas, kemudian minta bukti daripada gambar rajah atau ujian.
ms.teacherMoveQuote: Jadi maksud kamu [ulang suara]. Ceritakan lagi — apa dalam gambar atau ujian yang membuktikannya?
ms.pupilTarget: Menghubungkan tuntutan dengan bukti: "Bukti saya ialah ___ yang menunjukkan ___."

coachHints: Break teacher-talk IRF ('Good, next'). Script uptake moves: revoice the pupil's L1 or partial answer into clear Science English (TM-T03 Revoicing), then press for evidence from the diagram or test (TM-T04 Say More / TM-T08 Press for Reasoning).
Teacher script pattern: 'So you are saying [revoice]. Say more — what in the picture/test makes you say that?'
Sentence frames link claim to evidence: 'My evidence is ___ which shows that ___.'

strategies.name: Whole-Class Check & Adapt (AfL)
strategies.mechanism: Check every pupil at once (30-sec finger-vote, mini-boards, or 3-Pile Exit Check) to separate language stuck from concept error, then pivot on the spot (reset or firm_up).
strategies.teacherMoveQuote: Hold 1, 2, or 3 fingers on your chest. Let's see what we think before we move on.
strategies.teacherMove: "Hold 1, 2, or 3 fingers on your chest. Let's see what we think before we move on." (Strand 3 + reset/firm_up)
strategies.pupilTarget: 100% class response gives immediate diagnostic evidence; teacher adapts instead of moving on.

ms.name: Semakan Seluruh Kelas & Sesuaikan (AfL)
ms.mechanism: Semak semua murid serentak (undi jari 30 saat, papan mini, atau semakan 3 longgokan) untuk bezakan halangan bahasa dan salah konsep, lalu ubah suai serta-merta.
ms.teacherMoveQuote: Tunjukkan 1, 2, atau 3 jari di dada. Mari lihat apa yang kita fikir sebelum teruskan.
ms.pupilTarget: Respons seluruh kelas memberi bukti serta-merta supaya guru menyesuaikan pengajaran sebelum beralih.

coachHints: Include a 30-second whole-class check of EVERY pupil: finger-vote on the chest (1, 2, or 3), mini-boards, or a 3-Pile Exit Check.
Script the check: 'Hold 1, 2, or 3 fingers on your chest. Let's see what we think before we move on.'
For each outcome give the on-the-spot adaptation: separate 'language stuck' from 'concept error', then pivot (reset = re-teach with a concrete model; firm_up = press the reasoning forward).

strategies.name: Competing Claims & What-If Transfer (Concept Cartoons)
strategies.mechanism: Present 3 competing pupil claims (Ali, Bisi, Cempaka), prompt peer-to-peer agree/disagree with evidence, and push one "What-If" counter-example for far transfer.
strategies.teacherMoveQuote: Who fits the evidence best, and what is the trap in the other claim? What if we changed ___?
strategies.teacherMove: "Who fits the evidence best, and what is the trap in the other claim? What if we changed ___?" (TM-T08)
strategies.pupilTarget: Comparative reasoning: "I agree with [Name] because ___. If we change ___, then ___."

ms.name: Tuntutan Bersaing & Soalan Bagaimana Jika (Kartun Konsep)
ms.mechanism: Paparkan 3 tuntutan murid yang berbeza (Ali, Bisi, Cempaka), dorong murid bersetuju atau membantah dengan bukti, dan uji satu situasi "Bagaimana jika".
ms.teacherMoveQuote: Siapa paling menepati bukti, dan apa perangkap dalam tuntutan lain? Bagaimana jika kita ubah ___?
ms.pupilTarget: Penaakulan perbandingan: "Saya setuju dengan [Nama] kerana ___. Jika kita ubah ___, maka ___."

coachHints: Present THREE competing pupil claims about the topic (Ali, Bisi, Cempaka or other fictional pupils): one sound, one misconception, one language trap. Vary which pupil is right so pupils cannot guess by name.

Script peer-to-peer agree/disagree with evidence (TM-T08 Press for Reasoning with TM-T02 Turn and Talk / TM-T06 Challenging Thinking): 'Who fits the evidence best, and what is the trap in the other claim?'
Push ONE 'What-If' counter-example for far transfer: 'What if we changed ___?'
Sentence frames target comparative reasoning: 'I agree with [Name] because ___. If we change ___, then ___.'
